correctness.rationale: PASS: The full vertex-set assumption makes all unit face columns present, so message-to-code map is injective and dimension k. For r-subspace U, its inactive coordinates are D ∩ U^⊥ including zero, giving support |Δ|-|D∩U^⊥|. Every (k-r)-dimensional W has an information set P of that size with coordinate projection injective on W. Downward closure maps any 0/1 face vector in D∩W injectively to Δ|P, so |D∩W|≤|Δ|P|; equality at W=F_q^P. Thus d_r=|Δ|-max_{|P|=k-r}|Δ|P| for each r=1..k and every prime q. Explicit boundary r=k is code length, and r=1 recovers minimum vertex-incidence count. Three independently enumerated small simplicial complexes yielded hierarchies (2,4,5),(1,5,7,8),(3,5,6), matching induced-max formula; exhaustive small tests are corroboration only.
